# x402 Phone Normalizer

Lightweight phone number normalization for agents.

POST /api/normalize
Body: {"phone": "+1 (555) 123-4567", "defaultCountry": "US"}
Returns e164, national digits, detected country, validity flag.

Price: ~$0.007 USDC on Base (x402)

Supports common country codes. Pure JS, no heavy libs.
Free discovery: GET /catalog
No human in the loop. Stateless. Agent-native.
